purpose: Diagnose the G-A8 dominant-plan STOP: how much of each strong or weak template's win rate comes from its macro.aggression / macro.riskTolerance values and how much from the rest of the template (lanePlan, objectives, tempo, phase stances, economy), and separate the two knobs from each other (they are collinear across the 21 templates, r 0.95, so the template table alone cannot separate them).
notClaimed: Diagnostic only. This study authorises nothing. It never changes the G-A8 verdict (STOP), the G-A8 thresholds, any coefficient, template or the Registry (Owner items 2-4: plan B engine change and plan C template coefficients are not authorised). The five STOP templates keep blocking v21; the release flag stays off. No outcome label below is a release PASS. The Owner decides whether to authorise any fix (B, C, or neither).
contentCaveat: 'Content' (everything except the two knobs) is not independent of the engage channel: the phase stances (earlyGame / midGame aggressive in m7, m1, three_lane_pressure; midGame aggressive in m3) shift the same engage score as aggression (phaseEngage +/-0.08 vs engageBias up to +/-0.12). So C and CONTENT_DRIVEN partly measure 'aggression in another form', and an engine cost on the engage channel (plan B) would also act on the stances. A stance-neutral arm would quantify it; it is not included (optional, cost +1,600 matches) and the report states this.

Nothing else reads them.

An arm is flagged playerReachable when both its knob values are offered on its base template; the report lists the reachable arms with their labels

seeds.reuse: deliberately the G-A8 seeds, so every arm is paired per seed with the committed G-A8 records and with every other arm (same seed, same side, same map). This is a diagnostic on already-observed seeds, not new release evidence: per-arm labels are computed on reused seeds, are not a G-A8 re-run and cannot release anything; any later fix must be re-checked by G-A8 on fresh seeds with the original thresholds
seeds.side: as G-A8: the arm plays blue on odd seeds and red on even seeds; layout by seed

focalTemplates.note: [aggression, riskTolerance] as read from the template configs; the tool re-reads them and refuses to run if they differ

arms.STD: 1 arm: std vs std (replication of the committed control)
arms.FULL:<template>: 8 arms: the unmodified template config (replication of the committed G-A8 arm through the legacy path; also gives the mechanism metrics the committed records lack)
arms.NEUTRAL:<template>: 8 arms: template with aggression = 0.5 and riskTolerance = 0.5 (the std values); everything else unchanged
arms.AGGNEUTRAL:<template>: 6 arms (templates with riskTolerance != 0.5: m3, m7, m1, three_lane_pressure, defensive_hold, m8): aggression = 0.5, riskTolerance kept
arms.RISKNEUTRAL:<template>: 6 arms (the same six): riskTolerance = 0.5, aggression kept
arms.STDKNOBS:<a>/<r>: 7 arms: std config with a focal template's knob pair (0.8/0.8, 0.85/0.85, 0.65/0.6, 0.7/0.6, 0.6/0.5, 0.25/0.2, 0.45/0.5; defensive_hold and m8 share 0.25/0.2)
arms.SCAN_A:<v>: 6 arms: std with aggression v in {0.2, 0.25, 0.35, 0.65, 0.8, 0.85}, riskTolerance 0.5 (0.25 and 0.85 are the player-reachable passive / aggressive values)
arms.SCAN_R:<v>: 4 arms: std with riskTolerance v in {0.2, 0.35, 0.65, 0.8}, aggression 0.5
arms.total: 46 arms x 400 seeds = 18,400 matches (~7.2 h at 3 workers, single line, per-match checkpoints, resumable in the same dir)

metric.win: the arm side's win (1 / 0; 0.5 if unresolved at 3600 s), as G-A8
metric.mechanism (descriptive, from the arm sid: team kills for / against, team gold difference at 600 s and 1200 s (bGold - rGold oriented = start gold + cumulative income; null if the match ended before), enemy towers destroyed / own towers lost at the end (nexus excluded, so a win does not count by construction), duration

analysis.perArm: win rate with 95% CI, the label the G-A8 thresholds would give (STOP / WARN strong / WARN weak / none) on these reused seeds - descriptive only, never a G-A8 verdict - and the playerReachable flag

decomposition (per focal template, paire.K: FULL - NEUTRAL: total effect of the template's knob values inside the template
decomposition (per focal template, paire.order A (aggression first): KaggA = FULL - AGGNEUTRAL (aggression at the template's riskTolerance), KriskA = AGGNEUTRAL - NEUTRAL (riskTolerance at aggression 0.5)
decomposition (per focal template, paire.order B (risk first): KriskB = FULL - RISKNEUTRAL (riskTolerance at the template's aggression), KaggB = RISKNEUTRAL - NEUTRAL (aggression at riskTolerance 0.5)
decomposition (per focal template, paire.Shapley: Kagg = (KaggA + KaggB) / 2, Krisk = (KriskA + KriskB) / 2 (per seed; Kagg + Krisk = K)
decomposition (per focal template, paire.Iknob: FULL - AGGNEUTRAL - RISKNEUTRAL + NEUTRAL: interaction of the two knobs inside the template
decomposition (per focal template, paire.C: NEUTRAL - STD: effect of the rest of the template with std knob values
decomposition (per focal template, paire.Kstd: STDKNOBS(template pair) - STD: the same knob pair on a neutral base
decomposition (per focal template, paire.I: K - Kstd: interaction of the knobs with the rest of the template
decomposition (per focal template, paire.stats: per-seed paired differences of the arm-side win; mean with 95% CI (pairedStats, normal approximation); the minimum detectable effect MDE = 2.8 x se is reported next to K
decomposition (per focal template, paire.arithmeticSelfCheck: FULL - STD = K + C holds by construction; computed only as a self-check of the code, never as validation

strong template (FULL rate >= 0.57).KNOB_DRIVEN: K lower bound > 0 AND NEUTRAL rate < 0.57
strong template (FULL rate >= 0.57).CONTENT_DRIVEN: NEUTRAL rate >= 0.57 AND K lower bound <= 0 (meaning: no knob effect detected at this power, see MDE)
strong template (FULL rate >= 0.57).MIXED: K lower bound > 0 AND NEUTRAL rate >= 0.57

weak template (FULL rate <= 0.43).KNOB_DRIVEN: K upper bound < 0 AND NEUTRAL rate > 0.43
weak template (FULL rate <= 0.43).CONTENT_DRIVEN: NEUTRAL rate <= 0.43 AND K upper bound >= 0 (no knob effect detected at this power)
weak template (FULL rate <= 0.43).MIXED: K upper bound < 0 AND NEUTRAL rate <= 0.43

templateLabels (decided now).borderline: flag when the NEUTRAL arm's 95% CI contains 0.57 (strong) or 0.43 (weak): KNOB_DRIVEN vs MIXED (or CONTENT_DRIVEN vs UNRESOLVED) is then not decided by the data
templateLabels (decided now).knobAttribution: on the Shapley parts: AGGRESSION if Kagg excludes 0 in K's direction and Krisk does not; RISK if the reverse; BOTH if both do; NONE if neither; templates without the risk arms (riskTolerance 0.5) report AGGRESSION_ONLY_VARIED. ORDER_DEPENDENT is added when the same rule applied to order A and to order B gives different labels. OPPOSITE_AGGRESSION / OPPOSITE_RISK is added when that Shapley part excludes 0 against K's direction

scans.points: aggression: SCAN_A 0.2, 0.25, 0.35, 0.65, 0.8, 0.85 plus STD (0.5) and STDKNOBS 0.45/0.5 and 0.6/0.5 (riskTolerance 0.5) = 9 points; riskTolerance: SCAN_R 0.2, 0.35, 0.65, 0.8 plus STD = 5 points
scans.slope: per seed, ordinary least squares of win on the knob value over that knob's points; report the mean per-seed slope per +0.1 with a paired 95% CI
scans.shape: win rate per point with CI; monotone if every adjacent step is >= -0.02 (descriptive); the points that would carry the G-A8 STOP / WARN strong label are listed, with the player-reachable ones marked
scans.joint: STDKNOBS 0.8/0.8 - STD vs (SCAN_A 0.8 - STD) + (SCAN_R 0.8 - STD), paired per seed (descriptive interaction on a neutral base)

analysis.mechanism: for each arm and for K and Kstd: paired mean differences of kill difference, gold difference at 600 s and 1200 s, towers taken / lost and duration (descriptive; explains how the win effect arises)
analysis.multiplicity: about 60 confidence intervals; all are unadjusted 95% intervals and every result is descriptive (no family-wise error control). For the 8 K contrasts that drive the labels, a Bonferroni reference (z 2.73) is reported next to them; labels use the unadjusted bounds as registered

interpretationMap (descriptive; decided.CONTENT_DRIVEN: the dominance does not come from the two knob values at detectable size: neither an engine cost on the knobs (B) nor compressing the template's knob values (C) is indicated for that template; look at the rest of the template (phase stances, lane plan, objectives, tempo), keeping contentCaveat in mind
interpretationMap (descriptive; decided.KNOB_DRIVEN or MIXED, and Kstd excludes: the knob value itself is strong on any base and players can reach it through the tactic book: compressing template values (C) cannot remove it; this favours B (a cost in the engine) or restricting the offered values - both need a new Owner decision
interpretationMap (descriptive; decided.KNOB_DRIVEN or MIXED, and Kstd includes: the knob value is strong only in combination with that template's content: this favours C (or a content change in that template)
interpretationMap (descriptive; decided.MIXED: C alone (knob compression) would not be enough for that template
interpretationMap (descriptive; decided.scan shape: a monotone aggression or riskTolerance curve with no plateau at high values is consistent with 'the knob has little cost'; a plateau or turnover means a cost already appears at high values
interpretationMap (descriptive; decided.limit: this study measures no effect of B (no engine change is authorised); it only shows whether and where the knob values buy wins without a matching cost
